DELETE FROM app.ExceptiiPrezenta
WHERE Anul = @Anul
  AND Luna = @Luna
  AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

WITH Zile AS
(
    SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(@Anul, @Luna, 1) AS Data

    UNION ALL

    SELECT DATEADD(DAY, 1, Data)
    FROM Zile
    WHERE MONTH(DATEADD(DAY, 1, Data)) = @Luna
)

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS ZileLucratoare
FROM Zile z

WHERE DATENAME(WEEKDAY, z.Data)
      NOT IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday')

AND NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM app.ZiLibera zl
    WHERE zl.An = @Anul
      AND zl.Luna = @Luna
      AND zl.Zi = DAY(z.Data)
)

AND NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM app.ZiLiberaCCM zl
    WHERE zl.An = @Anul
      AND zl.Luna = @Luna
      AND zl.Zi = DAY(z.Data)
)

OPTION (MAXRECURSION 366)

ActionParameters.Value:
;WITH CO AS
(
    SELECT
        c.Marca,
        c.CodSucursala,

        SUM(
            ISNULL(
                CASE
                    WHEN MONTH(c.Interval1DatadeInceput) = @Luna
                     AND YEAR(c.Interval1DatadeInceput) = @Anul
                    THEN c.NrZileCO1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ,0)

            +

            ISNULL(
                CASE
                    WHEN MONTH(c.Interval2DatadeInceput) = @Luna
                     AND YEAR(c.Interval2DatadeInceput) = @Anul
                    THEN c.NrZileCO2
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ,0)

            +

            ISNULL(
                CASE
                    WHEN MONTH(c.Interval3DatadeInceput) = @Luna
                     AND YEAR(c.Interval3DatadeInceput) = @Anul
                    THEN c.NrZileCO3
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ,0)
        ) AS ZileCO

    FROM app.ConcediudeOdihna c

    WHERE c.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

    GROUP BY
        c.Marca,
        c.CodSucursala
),

CM AS
(
    SELECT
        m.Marca,
        m.CodSucursala,

        SUM(m.TotZileLucratoare) AS ZileCM

    FROM app.ConcediuMedical m

    WHERE m.AnulDePlata = @Anul
      AND m.LunaDePlata = @Luna
      AND m.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

    GROUP BY
        m.Marca,
        m.CodSucursala
),

SAL AS
(
    SELECT
        s.Marca,
        s.CodSucursala,
        s.Judet,
        s.TipNorma

    FROM app.Salariat s

    WHERE s.Anul = @Anul
      AND s.Luna = @Luna
      AND s.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
),
ALTEDREPTURI AS
(
    SELECT
        a.Marca,
        a.CodSucursala,

        SUM(ISNULL(a.ZileLiberePlatite,0)) AS ZileLiberePlatite

    FROM app.AltDrept a

    WHERE a.Anul = @Anul
      AND a.Luna = @Luna
      AND a.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

    GROUP BY
        a.Marca,
        a.CodSucursala
),
DIURNE AS
(
    SELECT
        d.Marca,
        d.CodSucursala,

        SUM(ISNULL(d.ZileDelegatie,0)) AS ZileDelegatie

    FROM app.Diurna d

    WHERE d.Anul = @Anul
      AND d.Luna = @Luna
      AND d.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

    GROUP BY
        d.Marca,
        d.CodSucursala
),
CFS31 AS
(
    SELECT
        c.Marca,
        c.CodSucursala,

        SUM(ISNULL(c.ZileCFS31,0)) AS ZileCFS31

    FROM app.CFS31 c

    WHERE c.Anul = @Anul
      AND c.Luna = @Luna
      AND c.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

    GROUP BY
        c.Marca,
        c.CodSucursala
),

SURSA AS
(
    SELECT Marca, CodSucursala FROM CO

    UNION

    SELECT Marca, CodSucursala FROM CM

    UNION

    SELECT Marca, CodSucursala FROM ALTEDREPTURI

    UNION

    SELECT Marca, CodSucursala FROM DIURNE

    UNION

    SELECT Marca, CodSucursala FROM CFS31
)

INSERT INTO app.ExceptiiPrezenta
(
    Marca,
    CodSucursala,
    Judet,
    Anul,
    Luna,

    TipNorma,
    TipInregistrare,

    ZileLucratoare,

    ZileLucrate,
    Zile12Norma,
    ZileProgramRedus,
    
    ZileLucrateTotal,

    OreLucrate,

    ZileCO,
    ZileCM,
    ZileLiberePlatite,
    ZileDelegatie,
    ZileCFS31,

    StatusValidare,
    MesajValidare,

    CreatedBy,
    CreatedDate,
    LastModifiedBy,
    LastModifiedDate,

    DataImport,
    EsteProcesat,
    Status
)

SELECT
    src.Marca AS Marca,

    src.CodSucursala AS CodSucursala,

    ISNULL(s.Judet,'') AS Judet,

    @Anul,
    @Luna,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Tip norma
    -------------------------------------------------
    ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) AS TipNorma,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Tip inregistrare
    -------------------------------------------------
    5 AS TipInregistrare,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile lucratoare luna
    -------------------------------------------------
    @ZileLucratoare,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile lucrate norma intreaga
    -------------------------------------------------
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) = 1
        THEN z.ZileCalc
        ELSE 0
    END AS ZileLucrate,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile 1/2 norma
    -------------------------------------------------
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) = 0.5
        THEN z.ZileCalc
        ELSE 0
    END AS Zile12Norma,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile program redus
    -------------------------------------------------
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) = 0.75
        THEN z.ZileCalc
        ELSE 0
    END AS ZileProgramRedus,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Total zile lucrate
    -------------------------------------------------
    (
    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Prezenta efectiva
    -------------------------------------------------
    ISNULL(
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) = 1
            THEN z.ZileCalc
            ELSE 0
        END
    ,0)

    +

    ISNULL(
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) = 0.5
            THEN z.ZileCalc
            ELSE 0
        END
    ,0)

    +

    ISNULL(
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1) = 0.75
            THEN z.ZileCalc
            ELSE 0
        END
    ,0)

    +

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Alte zile considerate prezenta
    -------------------------------------------------
    ISNULL(ad.ZileLiberePlatite,0)

    +

    ISNULL(di.ZileDelegatie,0)
    
    +
    
    ISNULL(0,0) -- ZileJustificate

    +
    

    ISNULL(0,0) -- ZileInvoire

    +

    ISNULL(0,0) -- ZileSomajTehnic

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile neplatite
    -------------------------------------------------
    -

    ISNULL(0,0) -- ZileCFS

    -

    ISNULL(0,0) -- ZileNemotivate

   

) AS ZileLucrateTotal,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Ore lucrate
    -------------------------------------------------
    (
    z.ZileCalc
    + ISNULL(ad.ZileLiberePlatite,0)
    + ISNULL(di.ZileDelegatie,0)
   
    )
    * ISNULL(s.TipNorma,1)
    * 8
    AS OreLucrate,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile CO
    -------------------------------------------------
    ISNULL(co.ZileCO,0) AS ZileCO,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile CM
    -------------------------------------------------
    ISNULL(cm.ZileCM,0) AS ZileCM,
    
    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile Libere Platite
    -------------------------------------------------
    ISNULL(ad.ZileLiberePlatite,0),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Zile Delegatie
    -------------------------------------------------
    ISNULL(di.ZileDelegatie,0),
    ISNULL(c31.ZileCFS31,0),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Status validare
    -------------------------------------------------
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(co.ZileCO,0)
           + ISNULL(cm.ZileCM,0)
           + ISNULL(ad.ZileLiberePlatite,0)
           + ISNULL(di.ZileDelegatie,0)
           + ISNULL(c31.ZileCFS31,0)
           > @ZileLucratoare
        THEN 'EROARE'

        WHEN ISNULL(co.ZileCO,0)
           + ISNULL(cm.ZileCM,0)
           + ISNULL(ad.ZileLiberePlatite,0)
           + ISNULL(di.ZileDelegatie,0)
           + ISNULL(c31.ZileCFS31,0)
           = @ZileLucratoare
        THEN 'OK_COMPLET'

        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS StatusValidare,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Mesaj validare
    -------------------------------------------------
    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(co.ZileCO,0)
       + ISNULL(cm.ZileCM,0)
       + ISNULL(ad.ZileLiberePlatite,0)
       + ISNULL(di.ZileDelegatie,0)
       + ISNULL(c31.ZileCFS31,0)
       > @ZileLucratoare
        THEN 'Total zile depaseste zilele lucratoare.'

        ELSE NULL
    END AS MesajValidare,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Audit
    -------------------------------------------------
    @UserId,
    GETDATE(),

    @UserId,
    GETDATE(),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Import
    -------------------------------------------------
    GETDATE(),

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Procesare
    -------------------------------------------------
    0,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Status
    -------------------------------------------------
    1

FROM SURSA src

LEFT JOIN CO co
    ON co.Marca = src.Marca
   AND co.CodSucursala = src.CodSucursala

LEFT JOIN CM cm
    ON cm.Marca = src.Marca
   AND cm.CodSucursala = src.CodSucursala

LEFT JOIN ALTEDREPTURI ad
    ON ad.Marca = src.Marca
   AND ad.CodSucursala = src.CodSucursala

LEFT JOIN DIURNE di
    ON di.Marca = src.Marca
   AND di.CodSucursala = src.CodSucursala

LEFT JOIN CFS31 c31
    ON c31.Marca = src.Marca
   AND c31.CodSucursala = src.CodSucursala

LEFT JOIN SAL s
    ON s.Marca = src.Marca
   AND s.CodSucursala = src.CodSucursala

CROSS APPLY
(
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN @ZileLucratoare
                 - ISNULL(co.ZileCO,0)
                 - ISNULL(cm.ZileCM,0) 
                 - ISNULL(ad.ZileLiberePlatite,0)
                 - ISNULL(di.ZileDelegatie,0) 
                 - ISNULL(c31.ZileCFS31,0)< 0
            THEN 0

            ELSE
                @ZileLucratoare
                - ISNULL(co.ZileCO,0)
                - ISNULL(cm.ZileCM,0)
                - ISNULL(ad.ZileLiberePlatite,0)
                - ISNULL(di.ZileDelegatie,0)
                - ISNULL(c31.ZileCFS31,0)
        END AS ZileCalc
) z
